07 / THE DETAILS

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Something else on your mind?
We’re a call or text away.

(385) 645-8996 ↗
Should I book a package or individual items?

A package groups tables and seating for a set number of guests, with the listed linens and extras. It’s an easy starting point. Individual rentals work well when you already have some pieces or only need a few items. You can add individual rentals to a package.

What’s included in the package price?

Each package’s item list shows exactly what comes with it. Listed prices are for a one-day DIY rental. Delivery, setup, takedown, and applicable tax are additional. Flowers, place settings, and other styling in photos are not included unless listed.

How do I check my date and reserve?

Choose a package and select “Check dates & reserve.” You’ll continue to Firefly’s booking store, where you can select the rental period, check availability, choose quantities, and complete checkout. A package selection here does not hold inventory.

Does delivery include setting everything up?

Standard delivery includes unloading in a driveway, curbside, or the nearest accessible area. Moving items further into a venue and setting them up are additional services. Contact us with your venue access, timing, and setup needs so we can confirm the cost.

Can I change the guest count or add items?

Yes, subject to availability. Contact us for a custom package, extra items, or changes to an existing booking. Farmhouse customers can also ask about upgrading chairs to benches. We’ll confirm availability and any price difference.

What is the deposit and cancellation policy?

Firefly’s current policy requires a 50% down payment. If an order is canceled within 30 days of the event, that deposit is forfeited. Review the rental agreement for complete terms, payment deadlines, and any conditions that apply to your booking.

What if something is damaged or my event is on a closed day?

Let us know promptly about damage or staining; repair or replacement charges may apply under your rental agreement. If you need rentals on a day the calendar shows us closed, call or text to discuss what’s possible.
